_fixture_note: NOT a probe run. This file exists so gen_card.py is runnable and testable today, and so the shape the honesty card WANTS is a concrete artefact rather than a request in prose. It differs from packages/trappoint-sql/g1-attestation.json in exactly three ways, each of which the card needs: it carries `inference`, it carries `cluster.gc_ttlseconds`, and it carries `not_built`. Every value below is transcribed from the accepted ADR, so the numbers are true even though the run was not.

cluster.note: Cloud Basic runs gc.ttlseconds=4500 (75 minutes). AS OF SYSTEM TIME therefore cannot reach further, and the long-horizon record is the application-level commit DAG.

vector_index_basic_tier.question: Does a VECTOR(n) column with a prefix-column vector index create and populate on the free Basic tier?
vector_index_basic_tier.statement: CREATE TABLE ... VECTOR INDEX idx (prefix..., emb vector_cosine_ops)

ann_requires_index_hint.question: Does an UNHINTED prefix-constrained ANN query traverse the vector index at demo corpus scale?
ann_requires_index_hint.statement: SELECT id FROM tbl WHERE prefix = $1 ORDER BY emb <=> $2 LIMIT $3
ann_requires_index_hint.result: index NOT used at 5200 rows; plan is top-k, render, filter, scan. The same query with @idx_name DOES traverse the index (GT-06b)
ann_requires_index_hint.fallback_if_absent: Every ANN arm pins the index explicitly; the CI EXPLAIN assertion asserts traversal of the NAMED index.

time_travel_window.question: How far back can AS OF SYSTEM TIME reach on this cluster?
time_travel_window.statement: SHOW ZONE CONFIGURATION; SELECT ... AS OF SYSTEM TIME '-1h'
time_travel_window.result: gc.ttlseconds = 4500 (75 minutes); a query past the window is REFUSED, not silently wrong

plpgsql_raise.question: Does a PL/pgSQL trigger RAISE EXCEPTION surface with the declared ERRCODE?
plpgsql_raise.result: raises P0001; diag.constraint_name and diag.context are both empty, so the message carries the raising object

sequences_are_creatable.question: Does CREATE SEQUENCE succeed on this cluster?
sequences_are_creatable.result: succeeds — therefore the CI lint banning sequences is load-bearing, not decorative

bedrock_rerank.question: Is Bedrock Rerank available in ap-southeast-2?
bedrock_rerank.fallback_if_absent: No dependency taken. Fusion re-ranks with our own arithmetic.

mcp_key_publication.question: Do the Managed-MCP terms permit publishing a service-account key for a judge?
mcp_key_publication.statement: terms re-read; no key issued at build time
mcp_key_publication.result: not measured — no MCP service-account key exists on this machine
mcp_key_publication.fallback_if_absent: Publish a key only on a separate throwaway mainline-verify cluster; otherwise ship a recorded session plus our own read-only endpoints, and say why in VERIFY.md.

unmeasured.note: A capability absent from `capabilities` is UNMEASURED. No renderer, card or voice-over may branch on one, and an unmeasured capability appears in the NOT-BUILT-YET column or does not appear at all.
known_open: aws_credentials_on_build_machine — invalid at build time. Nothing in the demo may REQUIRE a live AWS call; the renderer is offline by default and embeddings are committed fixtures.
webauthn_origin_binding_through_the_edge — GT-15 not run; the OIDC + signed-envelope fallback is pre-committed.
explain_query_over_managed_mcp_renders_the_prefix_spans_fragment — asserted over pgwire today; the MCP rendering is not yet measured.
